items.title: Mrs. Cozzy Cary Interview, 1960-10-27
items.q: I remember Robichaud, Jack Carey, and Buddy P.T. ... And he had a band.

ctx.x: What brass bands do you remember from the city here?

Oh, I remember Robichaud. And I remember Robichaud, Jack Carey, and Buddy P.T. and let's see what this other band name is. And he had a band. And Joe Oliver, he had a band. And the most older fellas I knew around here. See, Robichaud, he was an old-timer around here, you know. Where did he play? He was in the Excelsior band. Where did he play?
